items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) officially inactive after being unlikely to play; had not been full participant, may have worked out but held out after missing three games.
items.why: Quad strain; early in return process.
items.implication: Full clear for Jets backup RBs in larger roles.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry share spikes for remaining Jets backs.

items.text: ETR Sunday summary: Puka GTD/optimism, Breece GTD/pessimism (later inactive), Saquon expected, Lamar/DeVonta/Wicks OUT, Jacobs/Coleman/Kirk/Mason/Dell/Sampson IN. Projections updated.
items.implication: Core status board for lineup locks.
items.opportunity: Direct and implied opps from outs/ins.

items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks ruled out for MNF vs Cowboys.
items.implication: PHI pass game concentrates elsewhere; Goedert will play.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets for remaining Eagles pass-catchers; Hurts checkdowns.

items.text: Ravens ruled out QB Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) for third straight game vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley starts again. Was close but held out.
items.why: High ankle sprain; third consecutive miss.
items.implication: Huntley start suppresses Ravens pass game ceiling somewhat; Henry/Flowers/Andrews still viable but lower floor/ceiling.
items.opportunity: Increased checkdowns and run emphasis possible; Huntley streaming consideration limited.

items.text: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield active and returning from thumb dislocation; Egbuka inactive.
items.implication: TB offense upgrade; WRs without Egbuka.

items.text: All ETR projections updated to reflect latest injury/activation news (Lamar out, Puka opt, Breece pess/inact, Jacobs etc in).
items.why: Direct response to ETR status summary.

items.text: Buccaneers WR Emeka Egbuka OUT (concussion/foot); Baker Mayfield active/returning.
items.implication: TB WR targets redistribute with Mayfield back.
items.opportunity: Elevated roles for other Bucs WRs/TEs.

items.text: Steelers RB Rico Dowdle (knee, was Q) is up/active for Paris game vs Saints.
Rams optimistic Puka Nacua (calf, Q) will play vs Raiders; felt better Saturday, 'as long as no setbacks we feel good about him available.' Pregame workout expected; late afternoon kick.
items.why: Calf improved; minor per reports; McVay optimistic.
items.implication: Start with confidence if active; high upside vs LV. Adams already out long-term.
items.opportunity: Full target share if plays; monitor 90-min inactive.

items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo expected to resume lead back role vs Texans; JJ McCarthy long leash.
Eagles RB Saquon Barkley questionable but expected to play Monday vs Cowboys; DeVonta Smith OUT.
Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs from exempt; expected to play Sunday at Detroit.
items.implication: Workload question after layoff; startable but monitor shares.

items.text: Lamar/Puka/Breece statuses crucial for DFS main slate. Sneaky scratches: Brian Robinson, Tyler Warren, Emeka Egbuka. Tempted by CMC more slot amid 49ers WR outs despite usual skepticism on RB-as-WR.
items.why: News impact + 49ers WR injuries (Evans/Deebo out) + CMC smile comment.
items.implication: Updated ETR projections; CMC flex/WR consideration.
items.opportunity: CMC routes/snaps potentially expand; Egbuka out boosts TB others.

items.text: Justin Boone posted Sunday-updated Week 7 fantasy rankings reflecting latest news.
Jonah Coleman should be rostered in 100% of leagues; by year end the Broncos RB you wish you had. Go fix that.
items.implication: Priority add if available; future lead.

items.text: Davante Adams OUT (part of longer absence); impacts Rams WR room with Puka GTD.
items.implication: Puka even more central if active.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18) due to workload questions after long layoff.
items.why: Layoff rust and potential share issues.
items.implication: Fade or lower expectations despite activation.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown usage/matchup (WR10); also Kraft TE buffet vs DET, volume plays like Warren/Hubbard/Irving, Saquon if active. Hates Odunze (shadow), Downs, Kelce tough D.
items.implication: Prioritize these in lineups; DeVonta loved pre-OUT.
